info.title: IST Health Tele-Triage API
info.description: Generated from the routes the application registers and the zod request validators its handlers run (scripts/generateOpenApiSpec.ts). Request bodies and query parameters are described by schema; responses are described by status class, and by schema where the response was observed (docs/observed-responses.json, scripts/observeResponses.ts).

only.description: Comma-separated check names; all checks when omitted.

repair.description: Repair what can be repaired (default true).

NoteTemplateRenderBodySchema.description: Values for the template's fields, by field name.

OauthTokenBodySchema.description: Also accepted as application/x-www-form-urlencoded; the client may instead send HTTP Basic credentials.

post.description: Form-encoded callback from the messaging provider; its signature is verified. Not called by clients.
